instruction:

Produce a written audit report noting: (a) current headline and hero copy; (b) presence/absence of the seven template names, their stacks, setup descriptions, and start commands; (c) how courses/lessons currently link (or don't) to templates; (d) whether 'Free Courses', 'Practice Dashboard', and 'Paid Tiers' are explicitly highlighted in the hero path. output:
The audit report has been written to `.benzene/material/marketing/homepage-audit-2026-10-24.md`. Here's what it covers:

**(a) Headline and hero copy** — Documents that `docs/index.md` opens with the harness section (kicker "The harness", h2 "One architecture, six boilerplates", lede about `npx elegant` and three-layer shells), lists all seven subsequent sections, and notes there is no traditional hero block or hero CTA.

**(b) Seven template names, stacks, setup descriptions, start commands** — Confirmed absent. Only three `chota-*` projects are referenced (inside `docs/ui/template.md`, not the homepage): `chota-react-rtk`, `chota-vue-pinia`, `chota-wc-saga`. No stack table, setup descriptions, or per-template start commands exist.

**(c) Course/template linking** — Documents the four course groups from `docs/_data/courses.yml` and their lessons. Confirms no direct links from courses/lessons to templates; only a plain-text mention of four template families in ui-layer prerequisites (Angular mentioned but not among the three documented `chota-*` projects). Practice index has no template references.

**(d) Free Courses / Practice Dashboard / Paid Tiers in hero path** — Confirmed all three are absent from the hero path. Free tier exists in `pricing.yml` and courses index is titled "Free courses" but neither is featured on the homepage hero. Dashboard is linked from courses index but not mentioned on the homepage. Paid tiers (Pro, Lifetime) exist in `pricing.yml` but are not referenced on the homepage.

The acceptance criterion — audit report exists and covers all four areas (a–d) — should now pass.
